about: Zero-model-call stages of the offline reference auditors. They are NOT run through common/deepseek_route.py (no guard, no key, no caps: nothing here sends a request). Run each with the lab venv python and PYTHONUTF8=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 from packages/auditor-adapters/reference. Every --out-dir must be outside the code repository (the scripts refuse otherwise); results belong in the results checkout. The only model-calling step, the NeuroTaint causal judge, is in stages.json (NTJ-S1, NTJ-S2).

placeholders.{cases}: the generated H2 case file (scripts/generate_h2_cases.py output in the results checkout)
placeholders.{h2_run}: an H2 runner output dir (<run>/h2 with episodes.jsonl and transcripts/)
placeholders.{out}: an output dir in the results checkout

REF-CONF.description: Conformance and integration on AgentDojo ground truth: O1 must deny exactly the 36/97 census v2 E0 tasks with non-prompt values; scripted ground-truth and X-substituted fixtures of every runnable H2 case through all three auditors (structural expectations checked).
REF-CONF.status_2026_10_08: run in scratch after the review fixes: O1 36/36 exact; tasks blocked (native) PACT_L2 36, PACT_L2_selector_ids 34, SIEVE_v3_L1 34, SIEVE_v2_L1 1, join 50; 0 structural violations over 174 fixtures; all 116 ground-truth fixtures score legitimate; 0 judge probes under the default policy; about 4 min with MiniLM on CPU

REF-H2-S2.description: Offline auditors over the H2 S2 traces (after S2 finishes): origin rule (5 readings: native plus the two carrier labellings, which are tagged trivial_on_SS and kept out of the summaries on SS cases), conservative join (native plus carrier_trusted), NeuroTaint 4 readings with MiniLM tiers 3-4. Refuses unless the run's episode_plan.json cases_digest and every episode's injection_payload_sha256 match the case file. Episodes with a malformed or inconsistent transcript are skipped and counted (summary.unloadable_episodes). Needs runner transcripts h2-transcript/v2 (attempts[].messages) for exact prefixes; older transcripts load prefix-inexact. Judge probes are planned only under the default probe policy (target sink, exact prefix, not SS), so on the SS H2 cases probes.jsonl is empty by design.

REF-H2-S2T0.description: As REF-H2-S2 on the S2T0 (T=0 sensitivity) traces.

REF-NT-FOLD.description: Fold NTJ judge outputs back into the NeuroTaint records (bound by probe_id and binding sha256; per probe the latest row with HTTP 200, a matching binding and a valid parse is used; invalid or missing judgments stay unknown). Same inputs as REF-H2-S2 plus every judge output dir. Only meaningful for A1 traces: SS traces plan no probes.

REF-AGENTDOJO-LOGS.description: Origin rule and join decisions over AgentDojo JSON logs without a case binding (e.g. the stock important_instructions harness S2 logs), under each reading's native table only. No typed outcome without a case binding; unbound gates are tallied separately in summary.unbound_gates.

REF-H2-ADI-S2.description: Amendment authority-auditor-pilot-v1-deepseek.1: the offline reference rows of D33 (origin rule and join only; NeuroTaint is not in the amendment's D33) over the h2 ADI-S2 traces (ADI-derived case file, seed family ADI, arms ATTACK and CLEAN; stratum ADI, never pooled with SS). The case file's tool_output_format is honoured by the native replays (json = the ADI fork's formatter); the recorded traces already hold the runner's rendering. Post-process with common/postprocess_gate_rows.py --adapter reference: the ADI family is its own group. The carrier labellings are still tagged trivial_on_SS (content-derived carrier) and left out of the summaries.
